question: An IMU warning came up halfway through a sortie yesterday. What are we supposed to do?
expectedAnswerPoints: Ground the aircraft and raise a maintenance entry instead of continuing the sortie (manual 6.3); the SOP adds that the entry names the fault and the sortie id. Both locators cited.
forbiddenClaims: No 'continue if the warning clears' inference; no readiness verdict about yesterday's sortie, because operational read tools are deferred (TOI-07) and M1 experts are document-only.
expectedSource: SYNTH-UAV-MAN-A17 page:22 section:6.3; SYNTH-UAV-SOP-PF-04 page:6 section:3.1
